reviews.title: Product description is false - Cannot be mounted on wall or desk mount
reviews.comment: Purchased the "27 Inch 4K Gaming Monitor IPS, UHD 3840 x 2160p 144Hz PC Computer Monitors IPS Screen for Home & Office, HDMI, DisplayPort, Wall Mount Compatible" Absolutely false advertising. Item clearly states "Wall Mount Compatible." It is not. The manufacturing of the back makes it impossible to wall mount or use a desk mount. I would have never purchased this if I couldn't use a desk or wall mount.
reviews.author: Jennifer D

reviews.title: It doesn't even turn on.
reviews.comment: The monitor does not power on at all. And the back LED light doesn't turn on either. Plus its not even 4K. Terrible monitor and false advertising.
reviews.author: Phillip McGuffie

reviews.title: Monitor de juegos 4K de 27 pulgadas
reviews.comment: Excelente monitor, cumple con lo prometido, buenos colores y gráficos, bastante fluido, en mi caso lo uso para él día a día como dev, asi que no necesariamente le saco todos los recursos que tiene el monitor, pero para mi caso esta super bien.
reviews.author: Lucia Castaño
